杰米·查德维克在葡萄牙波尔蒂芒与威廉姆斯车队一起首次测试了一级方程式赛车
杰米·查德威克首次测试了F1赛车，她在葡萄牙波尔蒂芒为威廉姆斯车队试车，并形容这是“迄今为止我人生中最美好的一天”。
这位威廉姆斯大使兼天空体育F1评论员目前参加欧洲勒芒系列赛，周一在阿尔加维的赛道上，按照F1的旧车测试（TPC）规则，驾驶车队2025年登上领奖台的赛车完成了32圈。
28岁的英国车手查德威克是今年第二位测试F1赛车的女性，此前卫冕F1学院冠军多丽安娜·平于4月在银石赛道驾驶了2021年的梅赛德斯赛车；她也是自2023年杰西卡·霍金斯测试阿斯顿·马丁以来，首位测试F1赛车的英国女性。

查德威克说：“这是非凡的一天，也是一次难以置信的经历。”

"我对今天的一切感到无比感激和难以置信地开心。这是一段我会铭记很久很久的经历——我甚至可以说，这是我迄今为止人生中最美好的一天。"
苏茜·沃尔夫是最后一位在一级方程式周五练习赛中驾驶的女车手，她在2014和2015赛季为威廉姆斯车队参加了四节练习赛，而意大利人莱拉·隆巴迪则是最后一位参加大奖赛正赛发车的女车手，那是1976年。

威廉姆斯车队领队詹姆斯·沃尔斯表示：“杰米·查德维克是数百万女性和女孩的榜样，她在各个级别都打破了纪录，她完全配得上这次与阿特拉斯威廉姆斯F1车队进行测试的机会。
“杰米为车队收集了重要数据，因为F1明年将重返波尔蒂芒，她的反馈和表现令人印象深刻，正如我们早就知道的那样。”
“这清楚地表明，女性有一条通往最高水平竞技的道路，我期待看到杰米如何利用这次经验来提升她自己的驾驶水平，并为我们的年轻车手提供建议，告诉他们驾驶一辆一级方程式赛车需要付出什么。”
在前往葡萄牙之前，查德威克接受了天空体育的采访，详细讲述了她为这次测试所做的准备工作。
“我在模拟器里进行了半天的练习，还做了座椅适配以及所有你在测试前要做的流程性准备工作，”她说，“而且我实际上一直在加大颈部训练的强度。”
“显然，我参加LMP2（勒芒原型2组）比赛时本来就在训练颈部，但为了这次一级方程式测试，训练量自然而然地进一步增加了。”
"乔治·拉塞尔一直在帮助我做一些准备工作。在我和他第一次正式进行颈部训练后的第二天早上醒来，我几乎无法转动我的头！
"所以这真的很不可思议，当你意识到他们不仅要承受车内的考验，还要为颈部做这么多训练。简直太疯狂了。"
查德威克之前曾在欧洲勒芒系列赛中跑过波尔蒂芒赛道，她补充道："我和不少车手聊过这条赛道。
"奥利·比尔曼说，从心理层面来看，这实际上是最难应付的赛道之一。它的起伏节奏感很强，变化非常多。在脑子里会非常忙碌。
"我感觉自己在天空体育的这个角色里，从一级方程式整体上学到了非常多的东西，这对我正在做的其他所有事情都有很大帮助。
"但我觉得这件事将需要一种全新的、极其不同的方式。

detailEn: Jamie Chadwick tests F1 car for first time with Williams run in Portugal in 'best day of my life so far'

Triple W Series champion and Sky Sports F1 pundit completed 32 laps in Williams' 2025 car in the Algarve; first woman to drive Williams car since 2015; watch the full story of Jamie Chadwick's Williams test across Sky Sports F1's Azerbaijan GP shows on Friday and Saturday
Jamie Chadwick tested a Formula 1 car for the first time with Williams at Portimao in Portugal
Jamie Chadwick has tested a Formula 1 car for the first time with Williams at Portimao in Portugal - describing it as the "best day of my life so far".

The Williams ambassador and Sky Sports F1 pundit, who races in the European Le Mans Series, completed 32 laps in their podium-finishing 2025 car at the circuit in the Algarve under F1's Testing of Previous Cars (TPC) rules on Monday.

British 28-year-old Chadwick is the second woman to test an F1 car this year after reigning F1 Academy champion Doriane Pin drove a 2021 Mercedes at Silverstone in April, and the first British female to do so since Jessica Hawkins ran an Aston Martin in 2023.

Chadwick, who first joined Williams in 2019 as a development driver, has enjoyed a successful career in motorsport so far, winning all three seasons of the all-female W Series and, in 2024, becoming the first woman to win a road course race in the US-based Indy NXT series.
"It was a phenomenal day and an incredible experience," said Chadwick.
"Few things can prepare you for driving a Formula 1 car at speed around a track like Portimao, but it was everything I imagined and 10 times more.
"I'm incredibly grateful to Atlassian Williams F1 Team for this opportunity. I remember being young and watching Susie Wolff step into a Williams F1 car and how much that inspired my own journey.
Driving a Formula 1 car for the first time is pretty hard to put into words.
An incredible experience with @WilliamsRacing
Thank you to everyone who helped make it happen. A dream I’ve had since I was a little girl, finally ticked off the list 💙 pic.twitter.com/EjxMgKbi6l
— Jamie Chadwick (@JamieChadwick) September 24, 2026

"I'd love to be able to do the same for the next generation, and the experience I gained today will make a real difference both to my own racing and to what I can pass on to the drivers coming through.
"I'm so grateful and incredibly happy with how the day went. It's an experience I'll remember for a very long time - I'd go as far as saying it's been the best day of my life so far."

Susie Wolff is the last woman to drive in Friday practice in F1, completing in four sessions across the 2014 and 2015 seasons for Williams, while Italian Lella Lombardi in 1976 was the last woman to start a Grand Prix.
A milestone day in Portugal. More content coming soon 👀🎥 pic.twitter.com/GoYKCaZm1e

Williams team principal James Vowles said: "Jamie Chadwick is an inspiration for millions of women and girls who has broken records at every level, and she has thoroughly earned this F1 test opportunity with Atlassian Williams F1 Team.
"Jamie gathered important data for the team as F1 prepares to return to Portimao next year, and her feedback and performance were impressive as we knew they would be.

"This clearly shows there is a path for women to compete at the top level, and I look forward to seeing how Jamie uses this experience to advance her own driving and advise our young drivers on what it takes to drive an F1 car."
Speaking to Sky Sports before heading to Portugal, Chadwick detailed how her preparations for the test had gone.
"I did half a day in the sim, the seat fit and all the kind of procedural stuff that you do beforehand," she said. "And then I have actually been upping the neck training a lot.
"Obviously racing LMP2, I train my neck anyway, but that is naturally stepped up for an F1 test.
"George Russell's been helping me a little bit with the preparation. I woke up the next morning after the first proper day of neck training I did with him, and I could barely move my head!
"So it's incredible, actually, when you realise what they are going through in terms of not just in the car, but also the training that they have to do for the necks at the moment. It's crazy."
Chadwick had previously driven the Portimao track in European Le Mans, and added: "I've spoken to quite a few drivers about it.
"Ollie Bearman said mentally it's one of the toughest tracks, actually. Just this flow of it is very undulating. There's a lot going on. In the mind it's very busy.
"I feel like I learn a huge amount from Formula 1 just generally in the role that I have with Sky Sports, which has helped me a lot in all the other stuff that I'm doing.
"But I think this is going to take a new, extreme one from that."

法拉利的夏尔·勒克莱尔在周五的两节练习赛中均排名第一，但迈凯伦和梅赛德斯亮出实力，以0.1秒的优势超过了这位摩纳哥车手。

周六最后一节练习赛前又发生了更多戏剧性事件，哈斯车队做出令人震惊的决定，用替补车手平川亮替换埃斯特班·奥康，参加本周末剩余的比赛。

detailEn: Mexico City GP: Lando Norris pips Kimi Antonelli in final practice to set up thrilling Mexico qualifying

Lando Norris and Kimi Antonelli were separated by just 0.001s at the top of the timesheet in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix; watch qualifying later at 9pm with Sunday's race at 8pm (build-up from 6.30pm), live on Sky Sports F1

Sky Sports F1's David Croft and Karun Chandok discuss Esteban Ocon being replaced by Haas for the Mexico City GP, Liam Lawson and Max Verstappen being handed a grid penalty for their P2 collision and Isack Hajar's paddock altercation with a fan
McLaren's Lando Norris pipped Mercedes' Kimi Antonelli by 0.001s in final practice for the Mexico City Grand Prix to set up a thrilling qualifying.
Ferrari's Charles Leclerc had topped both of Friday's practice sessions but McLaren and Mercedes showed their hand to outpace the Monegasque driver by one tenth of a second.
Antonelli is likely to become world champion in Sunday's race as he only needs a top-nine finish to secure the Formula 1 drivers' title.

McLaren's Oscar Piastri was fourth while Red Bull appear to be out of the pole position battle as Max Verstappen was 0.351s off the pace, but there seems to be a genuine three-team fight at the front for qualifying later on Saturday at 9pm (build-up from 8pm), live on Sky Sports F1.
Regardless of what he does in qualifying, Verstappen cannot start on pole position as he and Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson have a one-grid place penalty for colliding in second practice on Friday.
The stewards called the incident "unacceptable", with both drivers admitting the clash was "unnecessary and clumsy".
Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson and Red Bull's Max Verstappen make contact during FP2 at the Mexico City GP - the clash would eventually lead to both drivers receiving a grid penalty
More drama took place before final practice on Saturday as Haas made the shock decision to replace Esteban Ocon with reserve driver Ryo Hirakawa for the remainder of the weekend.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad, with Brazilian youngster Rafael Camara signed as his replacement.
Hirakwa, a 24 Hours of Le Mans winner, has taken part in several practice sessions for Haas over the last two years and was 19th in final practice, six tenths down on team-mate Oliver Bearman.

detailZh: 埃斯特班·奥康：哈斯在墨西哥城大奖赛周末剩余赛程中由平川亮接替这位法国车手，未提供原因
埃斯特班·奥康将不再参加墨西哥城大奖赛余下环节，哈斯由平川亮接替这位法国车手；哈斯未说明换下奥康的原因；奥康将在本赛季结束后离开车队
埃斯特班·奥康已在哈斯被平川亮接替，参加墨西哥城大奖赛剩余赛程。
车队未说明换下奥康的原因，但确认这位法国车手并非患病。
奥康在第二次练习赛后以第13名完赛，在车队无线电中发泄了自己的不满，并且将不再参加本站比赛的任何环节，因为平川亮将在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道顶替他的发车位。
奥康质疑了车队在周五第二次练习赛中让他使用中性胎而非软胎的决定。
这位法国车手在被赛事工程师劳拉·穆勒告知其驾驶计划有变后，恳求道“别这样对我”。
哈斯车队最近确认，奥康将在本赛季结束后离开这支美国所有的车队，他已在队效力两年。
车队声明写道：“TGR哈斯F1车队储备车手平川亮将在本周末墨西哥城大奖赛的剩余赛程中替换埃斯特班·奥康，时间为10月31日星期六至11月1日星期日。”
“平川亮（32岁）曾随丰田GAZOO Racing两度赢得国际汽联世界耐力锦标赛冠军（2022年、2023年），并夺得勒芒24小时耐力赛冠军（2022年）。他于10月30日星期五在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道参加了第一节自由练习，这是他本赛季第三次驾驶VF-26赛车出战自由练习，最终位列全场第15名。”
“这位日本车手将在星期六的第三节自由练习和排位赛以及星期日的71圈大奖赛中与队友奥利·贝尔曼搭档——这将是平川亮的F1正赛首秀。”

detailEn: Esteban Ocon: Haas replace French driver with Ryo Hirakawa for remainder of Mexico City GP weekend without providing reason

Esteban Ocon will take no further part in the Mexico City GP, with Haas replacing French driver with Ryo Hirakawa; Haas gave no reason for Ocon's replacement; Ocon is leaving the team at the end of the season
Esteban Ocon has been replaced by Ryo Hirakawa at Haas for the remainder of the Mexico City Grand Prix.
The team provided no reason for replacing Ocon, but confirmed the Frenchman was not suffering from illness.

Ocon vented his frustrations on the team radio while finishing 13th following second practice and will take no further part in the race as Hirakawa will take his place on the grid at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez.
Ocon questioned the team's decision to run him on the medium rather than soft tyre during second practice on Friday.
The Frenchman pleaded "don't do this to me" to his race engineer Laura Mueller after being informed of a change to his run-plan.
Haas recently confirmed that Ocon will be leaving the team at the end of this season after two years with the American-owned squad.
A team statement read: "TGR Haas F1 Team reserve driver Ryō Hirakawa will replace Esteban Ocon for the remainder of the weekend's Mexico City Grand Prix, Saturday 31 October - Sunday 1 November.

"Hirakawa (32), a two-time winner of the FIA World Endurance Championship (2022, 2023) and 24 Hours of Le Mans Winner (2022) with Toyota GAZOO Racing, participated in FP1 at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodriguez on Friday 30 October - his third free practice outing of the season driving the VF-26, finishing 15th overall.
"The Japanese driver will partner teammate Ollie Bearman through final practice and qualifying on Saturday and Sunday's 71-lap grand prix - Hirakawa's Formula 1 race debut."
